description: Donated by the SAAF Museum at Swartkop and delivered to the Springs museum in November 2024 as its first aircraft, arriving disassembled with engine, tail and wings removed and reassembled on site; reported as about 15 metres long and roughly 10 tons, restored in about ten weeks. Serial NOT published in any source I found, so tail_number is deliberately blank. Confirmed present through a Citizen feature of 21 February 2025 and a Springs Advertiser follow-up of 15 January 2026. Visitors including children are allowed to climb into the aircraft.

Atlas Impala Mk I acquired by the Springs museum. As of a Springs Advertiser report of 15 January 2026 it was being restored by a local autobody firm, with the wings finished and the final silver-grey paint in progress. Serial not published in any source found, so tail_number is deliberately blank. This is the aircraft trailed as a planned acquisition in the February 2025 coverage.
